profile.name: Rifat Islam
profile.tagline: I build modern, fast and scalable web applications with MongoDB, Express, React & Node.js.

about.intro: Hi, I'm Rifat — a passionate MERN Stack Developer who loves turning ideas into interactive, user-friendly web experiences.
about.journey: My programming journey started during college, when I wrote my first lines of JavaScript and was hooked by how a few lines of code could bring a page to life. I began with HTML and CSS, moved into JavaScript deeply, and then discovered React — which completely changed how I think about building interfaces. Since then I've been learning the full stack: Node.js and Express on the server, MongoDB for data, and deploying real applications people can use.
about.whatIDo: I enjoy building pixel-perfect, responsive frontends and connecting them to clean, well-structured APIs. I love the moment when a design becomes a living product — solving problems, optimizing performance, and sweating the small details that make an app feel smooth. Currently, I'm focused on the MERN stack and constantly improving my craft.

education.description: Currently pursuing my bachelor's degree with a focus on software engineering, data structures, algorithms, and web technologies.
highlights: Special coursework in Web Engineering & Database Systems
Built multiple full-stack projects as semester capstones
Active member of the university coding club

education.description: Completed HSC with a Science background (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology) — where my curiosity about technology first began.

projects.name: BAZAR-DOR
projects.shortDescription: A full-stack task management app with boards, drag-and-drop, and team collaboration.
projects.description: TaskFlow is a productivity application that helps teams organize work into boards and lists. Users can sign up, create workspaces, add tasks with deadlines and priorities, and drag them across stages. It includes JWT auth, REST APIs, and a fully responsive React frontend.
challenges: Implementing smooth drag-and-drop across columns while keeping state in sync with the backend
Designing a secure JWT auth flow with refresh tokens
Optimizing re-renders in a large board with hundreds of cards
futurePlans: File attachments and comments on tasks
A mobile app version with React Native

projects.name: ShopZone
projects.shortDescription: An e-commerce platform with product search, cart, and a complete admin panel.
projects.description: ShopZone is a full-featured online store where users can browse products, filter by category and price, add items to a persistent cart, and check out. Admins get a dashboard to manage products, orders, and users. Built with the complete MERN stack.
challenges: Managing complex cart state that persists across sessions
Building efficient search & filtering with pagination on the API
Securing admin routes and protecting user data

projects.name: WeatherVision
projects.shortDescription: A beautiful weather dashboard with forecasts, charts, and city search.
projects.description: WeatherVision fetches live weather data from the OpenWeather API and presents it with interactive charts showing temperature, humidity, and wind trends over time. Includes city search with autocomplete, unit switching, and a clean dark UI.
challenges: Handling API rate limits gracefully with caching
Making charts fully responsive on all screen sizes
Showing useful empty, loading and error states for every scenario
